item.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD: Paul W.S. Anderson To Direct Live-Action Movie Starring Isabela Merced
item.description: A live-action movie based on Sega's The House of the Dead horror shooter video game series is in the works, and Superman and The Last of Us star Isabela Merced will play the lead...

item.title: Jagex Has Banned Over 1 Million Bots On OLD SCHOOL RUNESCAPE In One Month
item.description: Jagex has banned over 1 million bot accounts in Old School RuneScape during January 2026, a massive jump from December's 582k, signaling their aggressive anti-bot efforts amid ongoing player complaints.

item.title: DIABLO 2: RESURRECTED Ladder Season 13 Resets February 20th With Standard And Hardcore Races
item.description: Diablo II: Resurrected Ladder Season 13 launches February 20th at 5 p.m. PST, ending Season 12 on February 11th. Four ladder modes return for the 13th season.

item.title: DIABLO 4 Season 12 PTR Divides Players: Filler Season Or Smart Bridge To Lord Of Hatred?
item.description: The Diablo 4 Season 12 PTR is live through February 10th and draws mixed reviews with it's killstreaks, Bloodied items, and endless Butchers. Will this be a season to skip?

item.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Launches On Nintendo Switch 2 This Summer With An Exclusive MTG Card For Fans
item.description: Square Enix reveals Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Nintendo Switch 2 in June this year, with physical copies including an exclusive Magic: The Gathering Zack Fair card. Preorders are live now.

item.title: HBO's BALDURS GATE 3 TV Series Announcement Draws Mixed Fan Reactions, And Cautious Hope From Larian Studios
item.description: HBO's recently announced Baldur's Gate TV series, has drawn out mixed reactions over Larian Studios having no input on the series. Larian is still hopeful for the series.

item.title: Nintendo Fans Will Be Able To Enjoy The Latest DIGIMON Video Game On The Go This Summer
item.description: Bandai Namco has announced that Digimon Story: Time Stranger will be playable on the go with Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 consoles later this year.

item.title: HALO: CAMPAIGN EVOLVED Is Reportedly Targeting A Summer 2026 Release In Xbox's Stacked Line Up
item.description: It is being reported that Halo: Campaign Evolved is eyeing a summer 2026 launch before Fable and Gears Of War E-Day. Here is what we know about it so far.
